threads.title: 📌 Welcome to EyeDea: Platform Philosophy & Community Code of Conduct

posts.content:
### Welcome to EyeDea!

For years, internet culture thrived on classic bulletin boards like PinoyExchange, Symbianize, Mobilarian, and TipidPC. There was something magical about threaded, in-depth discussions with signatures, reputation badges, and thoughtful multi-paragraph exchanges.

**Our Mission:**
EyeDea is a sanctuary for high-signal ideas. Whether you are building an AI SaaS, debating startup economics, learning Next.js, or sharing book notes, this forum is built for you.

#### The Golden Rules:
1. **Focus on High-Signal Discussion**: Provide substance. If you disagree, attack the argument, never the person.
2. **Strictly Clean**: No adult content, piracy, or toxic personal attacks.
3. **Encourage Collaborations**: If someone shares a nascent idea, give constructive feedback or offer to test their prototype.

Start a discussion or drop a reply below!

threads.title: 💡 Idea Validation: An open-source payroll & tax calculator tailored for PH freelancers

posts.content:
Hey fellow builders!

I have been exploring an idea for Filipino freelancers and remote contractors:

**The Concept:**
A sleek, lightweight web app (Next.js + PWA) that:
1. Lets freelancers log invoice income in USD/PHP with automatic exchange rates.
2. Automatically generates tax computation estimates under the 8% preferential BIR rate.
3. Exports pre-filled values ready to copy-paste into eBIRForms.
4. Privacy-first: 100% client-side encrypted or local SQLite/IndexedDB so users own their financial data.

Would love feedback from fellow developers and freelancers!
